messages:
lina-partnerships: Quick sync — Datadog + HW SI + us to finalize OpenTelemetry Collector profiles and dashboard bundle for Private deployments. Goal: produce a one-click installer (collector config + dd dashboard JSON) for SI demos. Target demo: Tue Apr 5. Need: (1) collector configs for NVBench & A100 perf profiles, (2) dashboard JSON, (3) runbook for on-prem install + KMS mapping. Who can own each?

anya-obs: I can own the dashboard JSON and sample query notebooks. Is there an existing repo/PR to drop artifacts into?

lina-partnerships: @anya-obs github.com/redwood/obs-integrations PR #312 is the current landing spot — please add dashboards under /dashboards/marketplace and include a small README for expected metrics names. Also need mapping for KV-cache, batch_size, and per-token latency metrics.

steve-dd: Datadog side: we can produce the dashboard JSON and a marketplace tile. We'll add a default monitor for high request queue latency and a trace view for LLM spans. I'll aim to have a draft tile + dashboard by Mon.

sam-eng-runtime: For the collector profiles we should include memory_limiter and a light sampling processor to keep span volume sane. Quick example for the collector receiver/exporter section:

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DD_API_KEY}
    compress: gzip
processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 5s
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_mib: 2048
  probabilistic_sampler:
    sampling_percentage: 5.0
```

We need to validate this against Private on-prem GPU configs — KV cache and prefix caching generate many small spans. Sampling might need to be adaptive.

kevin-privacy: Heads up — Private deployments require explicit KMS/HSM integration notes and audit mapping for exported traces. The runbook must call out what gets redacted (prompt text), how keys are rotated, and where the Datadog exporter stores transient files. We also need a short SOC2-friendly blurb for the marketplace tile.

tom-sales: FYI — please don't publicize the joint demo until Partner Legal signs off. Suggest an embargo date of Apr 8 for any external assets. Coordinate PR/asset drop with marketing.

deploy-bot: Deployment smoke test: collector v0.7.2 + datadog exporter passed on staging. Samples ingested and dashboard panels populated. CI link: https://ci.redwood.dev/1234 (logs attached).

steve-dd: @sam-eng-runtime re: collector snippet — Datadog recommends max_retries: 5 on the exporter and enabling TLS/assert_hostname for airgapped uploads via a forwarding gateway. Also, compress: gzip helps bandwidth for customers on constrained links.

lina-partnerships: Action items recap: @anya-obs dashboard JSON + queries, @sam-eng-runtime collector config variants + perf runs for NVBench/A100, @steve-dd dd tile + monitor + exporter best-practices, @kevin-privacy runbook redaction + KMS notes, @tom-sales embargo/announce plan. I'll book a 30m sync for tomorrow 10:30 PT to review first drafts. Anyone need a different time?

anya-obs: Works for me. I'll push a minimal dashboard JSON by EOD with panels for token latency, batch size, KV cache hits, and a trace flamegraph sample.

tom-sales: I'll flag marketing/legal and confirm embargo window after sync.

kevin-privacy: I'll draft the runbook redaction section and share a short checklist for compliance checks before announce.

sam-eng-runtime: I'll run perf sweeps on A100/NVBench tonight and upload results to the PR (s3://redwood-obs/perf/4123456789).
